text:
maria-cs: Morning folks — quick status on Orion private-vpc onboarding. Two operational blockers: (1) KMS key policy missing Redwood service principal (decrypts failing in staging), (2) audit events & flowlogs not reaching our audit bucket. Also network egress currently only allows wildcard outbound which we asked them to tighten — they pushed back asking which IP ranges we need. Need owners and short ETAs.

tom-netops: I reviewed their NAT & SGs. Current outbound is 0.0.0.0/0 on 443/80. We require whitelisting to our egress proxies: 10.200.0.0/16 and the healthcheck subnet 10.200.5.0/24. Recommend they provision a static NAT for the jump host rather than ephemeral. If they won't, we can use short-lived SSH tunnel during cutover.

li-engr: Health check ports: TCP 8443 (app), TCP 9100 (metrics), and UDP 123 for time sync if they restrict NTP. Splunk HF ingestion port is TCP 9997. Canary needs outbound to that host plus S3 PutObject to the audit bucket.

vijay-kms: KMS detail: their key policy doesn't include arn:aws:iam::666777888:role/redwood-service-role. That causes kms:Decrypt to return AccessDenied. Minimal statement we asked them to insert: allow the role actions Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Also verify their key's keyUsage is ENCRYPT_DECRYPT and automatic rotation is enabled.

vijay-kms: Draft policy snippet to paste into their console: ```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::666777888:role/redwood-service-role"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
```

maria-cs: @olivia-cust can you confirm the Splunk ingestion FQDN and whether you can add the proxy CIDR and the static NAT IP? Also please share the S3 bucket ARN for the flow logs/audit.

olivia-cust: Splunk endpoint: splunk-orion.prod.internal:9997 (we'll open 9997). We can allocate a static NAT: 198.51.100.77. Bucket created: arn:aws:s3:::orion-redwood-audit-2026. I'll send the IAM role name for cross-account put via DM.

tom-netops: Great. Once NAT IP is provided we'll add it to SGs and update route table for jump host. Recommend they also enable VPC Flow Logs and send to that bucket; we need PutObject from their account to our audit role.

infra-bot: canary-check:privnet-canary-orion passed in staging. KMS decrypt simulated success after policy patch. Link: https://ci.redwood/infer/9987

li-engr: Note for SRE: ensure CloudTrail is capturing KMS events and that S3 bucket access logs are enabled so we can validate PutObject from customer's account. If any of those missing, the ingest pipeline will drop events silently.

maria-cs: Action items: tom -> apply SG + NAT mapping and validate connectivity; vijay -> send final policy snippet + test checklist; li -> prepare canary runbook and rollback steps; olivia -> DM role names and confirm bucket ACLs. I'll flag renewal owner because customer timeline compressing; if we slip more than 5 days they requested a contract extension conversation.

tom-netops: I'll action SG changes now; expect confirmation in ~90m after VPC owner applies changes.

vijay-kms: I'll also produce a minimal PR and run local decrypt/rotate tests once the role is added. ETA 2h.

olivia-cust: Policy applied and NAT IP set. Bucket ACLs set to allow PutObject from redwood-audit-role. Sending DM with role/account.

maria-cs: Excellent. li — canary scheduled tomorrow 09:30-10:00 PST. Please post the on-call link. I'll update the onboarding tracker and mark renewal risk.

li-engr: Confirmed. I'll monitor latency and errors; rollback plan uses traffic-shift-back to staging via feature-flag. Will notify #eng-oncall on start and finish.

maria-cs: Thanks team — closing the loop here. If any regression arises before canary, escalate to CS lead. :spiral_notepad:
